nodes.label: BDNF and TrkB
nodes.note: One node name covers secreted protein in a mouse slice, translated protein after eEF2K deactivation, a human genotype and a structural claim about the receptor; the assay has to travel with the edge [110,111,116,118].

nodes.label: Immediate-early genes (c-Fos, zif268)
nodes.note: Marks that tissue was driven; does not give the direction of a synaptic change [112].

edges.label: experiment, mouse motor cortex slice: potentiation required BDNF secretion and TrkB activation
genotype association, human: Val66Met carriers responded differently across TMS and tDCS protocols, replication inconsistent
experiment, mouse: NMDA receptor blockade at rest deactivated eEF2 kinase and released BDNF mRNA for translation
structure, cell work and mouse behaviour from one laboratory: binding to a site in the TRKB transmembrane domain
same laboratory: LSD and psilocin bind TrkB, and mouse plasticity required TrkB but not 5-HT2A
edges.note: Rival accounts put the work at 5-HT2A, intracellular [92] or presynaptic [174], with the plasticity question treated as open [173].

edges.label: experiment, rat prefrontal cortex: a single dose activated mTOR, raised synaptic proteins and added spines; rapamycin blocked both
contested: no direct target found for (2R,6R)-hydroxynorketamine, against a shared downstream NMDA-receptor requirement across four unrelated compounds in mice
experiment, rat: 1 Hz and 10 Hz raised c-Fos across cortex, iTBS only in limbic cortices, so the response tracked pattern not pulse count
experiment, mouse: spatial transcriptomics after two low-intensity protocols changed plasticity-related genes by region, layer and protocol
direction needs a synaptic readout, not a marker: iTBS600 produced LTP with spine remodelling in mouse organotypic slice culture
experiment, in vitro: light restored cytochrome c oxidase activity against cyanide, with an action spectrum matching the oxidised enzyme; nitric oxide proposed as the signalling step
edges.species: in vitro, primary neurons and HeLa cells

edges.label: experiment, rat: five days of 200 microamp anodal tDCS changed glycolysis, mitochondrial and calcium-signalling markers; current density far above human values
effector rather than endpoint: astrocytic TRPA1 opening drives Best1 glutamate release onto neuronal NMDA receptors
experiment, mouse: cortical astrocytic calcium surges with little neuronal firing change; the sensory enhancement required alpha1-adrenergic and IP3R2-dependent astrocytic calcium
contested, rat: sterile inflammatory response lasting about 24 h, against no NF-kB change at clinical imaging microbubble doses
experiment, rat: stimulation during lethal endotoxaemia inhibited hepatic TNF synthesis, with ChAT-expressing splenic T cells required as a relay
contested, mouse: lower amyloid with microglial change and a glymphatic route, against a null finding no native gamma engagement and no plaque change
null, macaque: cTBS or iTBS for three to four weeks changed neither TSPO PET nor MR spectroscopy, with TSPO not indexing activation in primates
